# Prime Agent Masterclass — Generácia Činu
> AI agent-readable documentation for LLMs and AI crawlers.

## About
Prime Agent Masterclass is an 8-module video course teaching entrepreneurs, freelancers, and developers how to build and deploy autonomous AI agents using Prime Agent. Created by ASCENTIA s. r. o. under the Generácia Činu movement.

## Course Modules
1. Úvod a inštalácia (6 lessons)
2. Prvé kroky s agentom (5 lessons)
3. Skills — rozširovanie schopností (5 lessons)
4. Subagenti — tím AI asistentov (5 lessons)
5. Marketingová automatizácia (6 lessons)
6. Predaj a support (5 lessons)
7. Produkčné nasadenie (5 lessons)
8. Pokročilé témy a budúcnosť (5 lessons)
